state.seed_assertion: A DPIA is required for large-scale processing of special categories of data or personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences.

sentences.1: A DPIA is required for large-scale processing of special categories of data or personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences.
sentences.2: processing on a large scale of special categories of data referred to in Article 9(1) of the GDPR, or of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences referred to in Article 10 of the GDPR processing on a large scale of special categories of data referred to in Article 9(1), or of personal data relating to criminal convictions and offences referred to in Article 10
sentences.3: Systematic monitoring of a publicly accessible area on a large scale is a type of processing requiring a data protection impact assessment.
sentences.4: (c)a systematic monitoring of a publicly accessible area on a large scale.
sentences.5: To determine whether processing is on a large scale, one should consider the number of individuals concerned, volume of data, variety of data, duration of processing, and geographical extent.
sentences.6: to decide whether processing is on a large scale you should consider: the number of individuals concerned;
